name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.dek: Citrix NetScaler. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 7 October.

items.title: Passing the Test You Trained On: Re-evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors for LLM Agents
items.dek: Prompt-injection detector rankings on public benchmarks do not predict performance inside agents; best detector on BIPIA catches only 2% of AgentDojo injections.
items.unproven: whether findings generalize to detectors not evaluated or to agent architectures beyond the two benchmarks tested

items.title: Threat-Preserving Representation Sensitivity in Agent-Security Benchmarks
items.dek: Representation sensitivity in agent security benchmarks causes 11–13 percentage point ASR swings from threat-neutral naming alone.
items.unproven: limited to three benchmarks and two model families; does not establish whether ASR as a metric remains valid or should be abandoned

items.title: Reasoning Models Are Accurate but Unsound on Identification
items.dek: Formal certification shows reasoning models have 36–45% false-claim rates on causal identification despite high accuracy scores.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to three models; does not address deployment in production reasoning pipelines; no mitigation strategy provided

items.title: Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation
items.dek: Formal verification of mechanistic edits certifies skill removal and preservation over continuous input regions without exhaustive testing.
items.unproven: toy networks and standard transformer only; does not scale to models deployed in production; no comparison to existing unlearning audits

items.title: CorrectGuard: Eyes-Off Correctness Estimation for Black-Box Security Guardrails
items.dek: Privacy-preserving guardrail auditing framework estimates correctness on inaccessible inputs using proxy models and leave-one-out evaluation.
items.unproven: 13 datasets but no guardrail deployment details; does not establish false-negative rates critical for production security decisions; proxy model reliability unvalidated

items.title: EvoRiskBench: An Evolving Benchmark for Runtime Security Risks in Workspace Agents
items.dek: EvoRiskBench provides 450 adversarial tasks across agent scenarios; framework for assessing workspace agent security risks during development.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to three LLM models and three harnesses; generalization to reader's specific agent deployments uncertain

items.title: Xray-core concealed a certificate verification bypass vulnerability
items.dek: Xray-core had a certificate verification bypass; no exploitation details or patch status provided.
items.unproven: whether the vulnerability is exploitable in reader's deployment, patch availability, or prevalence in financial services networks

items.title: Show HN: Pi pod – Run your pi coding agent in sandboxes on your own server
items.dek: Sandboxed execution harness for Pi coding agent on self-hosted infrastructure, avoiding per-token vendor lock-in.
items.unproven: Security properties of the sandbox isolation, scalability beyond the submitter's team, integration with existing SDLC tooling and policy enforcement.

items.title: Constant-Rate Certified Deletion
items.dek: Constant-rate certified deletion constructions for quantum-based primitives, improving qubit overhead from linear to constant.
items.unproven: quantum primitives without classical cryptographic analog; no near-term applicability as post-quantum migration planning involves classical algorithms

items.title: A Secure dToF LiDAR SoC with Dual-Domain Fingerprinting and Event-Driven AFE Circuit Achieving Sensor-Level Attack Resilience
items.dek: Hardware-based dToF LiDAR SoC with dual-domain fingerprinting and event-driven AFE defeating laser-injection spoofing attacks.
items.unproven: automotive and sensor security outside application security remit; no SAST/DAST/SCA integration pathway; reader does not ship hardware

items.title: Persona Guardrail: A Production-Grade Defense Framework for Agentic Systems
items.dek: Persona Guardrail enforces functional boundaries on agents via semantic allowlist/blocklist, improving out-of-domain detection to 93.5%.
items.unproven: commercial product; evaluation on single benchmark with limited real-world deployment data

items.title: Defense-in-Depth at the Perception-Reasoning Interface of LLM-Centric Agentic UAV Swarms
items.dek: Five-layer defense stack for LLM-controlled UAV swarms derives closed-form distortion bounds for sensor-report manipulation.
items.unproven: evaluated only in simulation; UAV swarms are not within reader's typical infrastructure or SDLC scope

items.title: Unitary complexity in polynomial space
items.dek: Complexity theory paper linking quantum commitments to longstanding open problems in circuit lower bounds.
items.unproven: no application to cryptographic practice; purely theoretical with no implementation or concrete security implications

items.title: PoCoFL: POlicy-COmpliant Federated Learning
items.dek: Framework for verifiable federated learning using zero-knowledge proofs and commitments to enforce policy compliance.
items.unproven: no empirical evaluation on real federated deployments; no performance overhead measurement; applicability to production ML pipelines unclear

items.title: Quantum Fire with Delegated Cloning
items.dek: Quantum cryptographic primitive adding delegated cloning capability to quantum fire via keyed access control.
items.unproven: purely theoretical; no hardware implementation; no path to deployment in systems the reader operates

items.title: PrivDev: Mapping Static-Analysis Data Types to DPV
items.dek: Maps 122 Bearer CLI static-analysis data types to GDPR-linked DPV categories via LLM and deterministic matching.
items.unproven: single SAST tool; LLM grading introduces subjective validation (AC1 0.68); no evidence of adoption or scanner accuracy improvement

items.title: Reversing the Clock: Layout-Aware Recovery of Design Intent from Clock Distribution Networks
items.dek: Hardware reverse engineering recovers clock distribution networks from IC images; outside application security scope.
items.unproven: not applicable to reader's domain

items.title: LiBRA: Detection-Aware Image Watermark Removal via Bidirectional Latent Optimization
items.dek: Attack removes AI-generated image watermarks while preserving quality; outside reader's infrastructure or SDLC responsibility.
items.unproven: not applicable to reader's domain

items.title: Show HN: Made an open-source Lego AI generator
items.dek: Python toolset enables LLM agents to generate LEGO CAD models by producing LDraw assembly-language source code.
items.unproven: Toy application; no evaluation of model correctness, buildability, or constraint satisfaction; not relevant to application security engineering.

items.title: Dirty Optimization Secrets (C for Playdate)
items.dek: Optimization techniques for embedded C on a handheld gaming device.
items.unproven: entirely outside the reader's remit; applies only to Playdate platform development

items.title: Quantifying Ethereum Energy Consumption via Network Mapping
items.dek: Ethereum energy consumption estimated at 415 kW by mapping peer attributes; outside reader's application security remit.
items.unproven: not applicable to reader's domain

items.title: ArtCraft Apps – open-source Adobe compatible suite written in Rust
items.dek: Open-source Adobe-compatible suite in Rust launches; no security angle identified.
